```{r}
gu<-readRDS(here::here("results","recovery","Gumbel_datasets.RData"))
ga<-readRDS(here::here("results","recovery","Gaussian_datasets.RData"))

mod_comp<-tibble(
  winning_model=rep(NaN,200),
  generative_model=rep(NaN,200),
  any_pareto_k=rep(NaN,200),
  significant=rep(NaN,200),
  meanrhat=rep(NaN,200),
  sum_div=rep(NaN,200)
  )
for(idx in 1:100){
  if(is.list(ga[[idx]])){
    mr<-ga[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% 
      filter(variable=='gm[1]')
    
    mod_comp$generative_model[idx]<-1
  
    if(mr$models[1]=='Gaussian'){
      mod_comp$winning_model[idx]<-1
    }else{
      mod_comp$winning_model[idx]<-2
    }
    
    mod_comp$significant[idx]<-(min(mr$elpd_diff)/2*mr$se_diff[mr$elpd_diff==min(mr$elpd_diff)])<(-2)
    
    
    mod_comp$any_pareto_k[idx]<-sum(mr$pareto_k_over_0.7)>1
    mod_comp$sum_div[idx]<-sum(mr$mean_div)>0
    mod_comp$meanrhat[idx]<-mean(mr$meanrhat)>1.01
  }
}
for(idx in 1:100){
  mdx=idx+100
  
  if(is.list(gu[[idx]])){
    mr<-gu[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% 
      filter(variable=='gm[1]')
    
    mod_comp$generative_model[mdx]<-2
  
    if(mr$models[1]=='Gaussian'){
      mod_comp$winning_model[mdx]<-1
    }else{
      mod_comp$winning_model[mdx]<-2
    }
    
    mod_comp$significant[mdx]<-(min(mr$elpd_diff)/2*mr$se_diff[mr$elpd_diff==min(mr$elpd_diff)])<(-2)
    
    
    mod_comp$any_pareto_k[mdx]<-sum(mr$pareto_k_over_0.7)>1
    mod_comp$sum_div[mdx]<-sum(mr$mean_div)>0
    mod_comp$meanrhat[mdx]<-mean(mr$meanrhat)>1.01
  }
}


mod_comp<-mod_comp %>% filter(sum_div==0,!is.na(winning_model))
test<-tibble(n=rep(NaN,4),n_sig=rep(NaN,4))
for(gen in 1:2){
  for(win in 1:2){
    test$generative_model[win+(gen-1)*2]=gen
    test$winning_model[win+(gen-1)*2]=win
    test$n[win+(gen-1)*2]=sum(mod_comp$winning_model[mod_comp$generative_model==gen]==win)
    test$n_sig[win+(gen-1)*2]=sum(mod_comp$winning_model[mod_comp$generative_model==gen & mod_comp$significant==1]==win)
    test$n_tot[win+(gen-1)*2]=sum(mod_comp$generative_model==gen)
  }
}

test<-test %>%
  mutate(
    prop=n/n_tot,
    prop_sig=n_sig/n_tot,
    prop_lb=qbeta(.05,1+n,1+n_tot-n),
    prop_ub=qbeta(.95,1+n,1+n_tot-n)
    )
test %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_tile(aes(x=as.factor(generative_model),y=as.factor(winning_model),fill=n/n_tot))+
  geom_text(aes(x=as.factor(generative_model),y=as.factor(winning_model),label=paste0(round(prop,2),'\n[',round(prop_lb,2),' - ',round(prop_ub,2),']')),color=rgb(.4,.4,.4))+
  xlab('Generative model')+
  ylab('Winning model')+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = 'none',
         axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90,hjust=0.5))+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=1:2,labels = c('Gaussian','Gumbel'))+
  scale_y_discrete(breaks=1:2,labels = c('Gaussian','Gumbel'))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "black", high = "white",limits=c(0,1))+
  ggtitle('Model recovery')

  
ggsave(here::here("figures",'Figure3A.png'),units = 'cm',width = 7,height = 6.5)

```

```{r}
mr_gaussian <- map_dfr(1:100, function(idx){
  if(is.list(ga[[idx]])){
      md<-ga[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% filter(variable=='gm[1]',models=='Gaussian')
      if(md$mean_div==0){
        ga[[idx]][[3]][[2]] %>%
        mutate(idx = idx,dataset='gaussian')
      }
    }
  }
)
mr_gumbel <- map_dfr(1:100, function(idx){
  if(is.list(gu[[idx]])){
      md<-gu[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% filter(variable=='gm[1]',models=='Gumbel')
      if(md$mean_div==0){
        gu[[idx]][[4]][[2]] %>%
        mutate(idx = idx+100,dataset='gumbel')
      }
    }
  }
)

mr_all <- bind_rows(mr_gaussian, mr_gumbel)%>%
  mutate(recovered=simulated>q5&simulated<q95)

recovery_rate<-
  mr_all %>% 
  filter(!is.na(q5)) %>% 
  group_by(variable,dataset) %>% 
  summarise(
    n=sum(!is.na(recovered)),
    recovery_rate=mean(recovered),
    lb=qbeta(.05,1+recovery_rate*n,1+(1-recovery_rate)*n),
    ub=qbeta(.95,1+recovery_rate*n,1+(1-recovery_rate)*n)
    )

combined<-
  mr_all %>% 
  full_join(recovery_rate)

combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='mu_alpha') %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=simulated,ymin=q5,ymax=q95,color=dataset))+
  geom_text(aes(x=25,y=-40+10*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset))+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('Group mean threshold')


ggsave(here::here("figures",'Figure3B.png'),units = 'cm',width = 8,height = 6.5)

combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='mu_beta') %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=simulated,ymin=q5,ymax=q95,color=dataset))+
  geom_text(aes(x=-2.5,y=-1+.35*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset))+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('Group mean log(slope)')


ggsave(here::here("figures",'Figure3C.png'),units = 'cm',width = 8,height = 6.5)

combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='mu_lambda') %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=simulated,ymin=q5,ymax=q95,color=dataset))+
  geom_text(aes(x=-3,y=-10+.8*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset))+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('Group mean half-logit(lapse)')+
  ylim(c(-10,0))

ggsave(here::here("figures",'Figure3D.png'),units = 'cm',width = 8,height = 6.5)

combined %>% 
  filter(variable%in%c('tau_alpha','tau_beta','tau_lambda')) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=simulated,ymin=q5,ymax=q95,color=dataset))+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  facet_wrap(variable~.,scales = 'free')

ggsave(here::here("figures",'FigureRecoveryTaus.png'),units = 'cm',width = 18,height = 8)
```

## subject level parameter recovery:

```{r}
mr_gaussian <- map_dfr(1:100, function(idx){
    if(is.list(ga[[idx]])){
      md<-ga[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% filter(variable=='gm[1]',models=='Gaussian')
      if(md$mean_div==0){
        ga[[idx]][[3]][[1]] %>%
        mutate(idx = idx,dataset='gaussian')
      }
    }
  }
)
mr_gumbel <- map_dfr(1:100, function(idx){
    if(is.list(gu[[idx]])){
      md<-gu[idx][[1]][[2]] %>% filter(variable=='gm[1]',models=='Gumbel')
      if(md$mean_div==0){
        gu[[idx]][[4]][[1]] %>%
        mutate(idx = idx+100,dataset='gumbel')
      }
    }
  }
)

mr_all <- bind_rows(mr_gaussian, mr_gumbel) %>% 
  mutate(participant=as.numeric(participant))%>% 
  mutate(recovered=simulated>q5&simulated<q95)


recovery_rate<-
  mr_all %>% 
  filter(!is.na(q5)) %>% 
  group_by(variable,dataset) %>% 
  summarise(
    n=sum(!is.na(recovered)),
    recovery_rate=mean(recovered),
    lb=qbeta(.05,1+recovery_rate*n,1+(1-recovery_rate)*n),
    ub=qbeta(.95,1+recovery_rate*n,1+(1-recovery_rate)*n)
    )

combined<-
  mr_all %>% 
  full_join(recovery_rate)

a<-
  combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='alpha') %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=simulated,ymin=q5,ymax=q95,color=dataset),alpha=.5)+
  geom_text(aes(x=-25,y=50+10*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset),size=2)+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('Threshold')

b<-
  combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='beta') %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=log(simulated),ymin=log(q5),ymax=log(q95),color=dataset),alpha=.5)+
  geom_text(aes(x=-3,y=5+2*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset),size=2)+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('log(slope)')

l<-
  combined %>% 
  filter(variable=='lambda') %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0,slope=1))+
  geom_linerange(aes(x=logit(2*simulated),ymin=logit(2*q5),ymax=logit(2*q95),color=dataset),alpha=.5)+
  geom_text(aes(x=-8,y=2+2*as.numeric(dataset=='gaussian'),label=sprintf("%.2f [%.2f - %.2f]",round(recovery_rate,2),round(lb,2),round(ub,2)),color=dataset),size=2)+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2','#E69F00'))+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  xlab('Ground truth')+
  ylab('Estimate')+
  ggtitle('logit(lapse rate)')


fig_recovery <- a + b + l
print(fig_recovery)
ggsave(
  here::here("figures","FigureSubjectRecov.png"),
  fig_recovery,
  units = "cm",
  width = 18,
  height = 8
)
```
